tools.description: The Silver Searcher - ultra-fast text search with smart defaults and .gitignore support
tools.usage:
ag 'pattern' # Search in current directory
ag -i 'case insensitive' # Case insensitive search
ag -l 'pattern' # Show only filenames
ag -A 3 -B 3 'pattern' # Show 3 lines before/after
ag --js 'function' # Search only JavaScript files
